chapter_title: What is Virginal; or, otherwise, what is Continent
spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation
:
 On
 the Virg
inal and the
 Continent

---


**
¶3.
** What
 is called *
prist
ine* belongs
 to the mystery of the interior celestial
 degrees. It is named
 *pristine* according
 to the category of all divine
 wisdom that has
 never entered into spiritual death, nor come
 under the assault of falsity and evil
 w
aging
 against
 it
.
 It
 is wisdom
 in
 its
 original
 innoc
ence, unt
ouched by any opposite
.


**¶4.** However
, what is called *recovered
* pert
ains to the mystery of that
 wisdom which descended and
 became confused with falsity. It was
 contaminated in
 the
 states
 of the proprium and the external natural
 man, yet was afterward elevated back toward
 interior wisdom. This state
 of
 pur
ified
 return
 they called *recovered
*.


**¶5.** Furthermore
, the holy
 pristine wisdoms —
 should they go forth against the assault of
 falsity and
 evil — do not enter into
 spiritual death,
 nor are
 they dimin
ished by it.


**¶6.** On
 the other hand, what is called *
recovered* is that wisdom which became confused
 with falsity, was purified,
 was drawn
 up out
 of all cr
eaturely and
 external
 states, and was confirmed in the interior
 celestial degrees. It is called *
recovered* because it experienced the desire belonging
 to the proprium and
 to
 self
-love;
 but afterward
 it was cleansed from that
 desire and became a holy state.


**¶7.** Furthermore,
 what is called *pristine* is
 that wisdom which was purified through the
 mediating influx of the Divine
 Itself —
 the form
 in
 which the
 Lord
 presents
 Himself to the
 understanding
. It was elevated and attained the
 in
most heights of
 perception
.
 It was confirmed in the likeness of
 celest
ial qualities themselves
 —
 which
 is to
 say, it
 was received
 into the forms
 of divine
 good
 and
 truth that
 constitute
 the heav
ens
 of
 the interior
 mind
.

**¶8.**
 Again, what is called
 *recovered* is the remainder of that
 wisdom which was left behind when
 the
 first
 portion
 was
 purified and
 elevated. It passes through successive states,
 ascending and descending through
 changes
 of
 spiritual
 condition
. Moreover
, a part
 of it enters into the form
 of the natural external person. And even
 that portion shall
 be received in
 the natural man, shall accept the interior
 faith
 and
 trust
 that
 looks
 toward the Lord, and shall become a
 holy state.
 This too
 they
 name
 *recovered*
 — for
 it was once
 held
 capt
ive in
 fals
ity and has
 returned
.


**¶9.** Furthermore
, what is named
 *pristine* is the Divine
 Wisdom flowing
 directly
 into the understanding —
 when
 it enters and
 forms itself within
 those who are in states of genuine good
 and
 recept
ive charity
. However
, on
 the other hand, what is called *
recovered* is the new regenerate will
 and understanding, when it is purified
 from the old proprium —
 the
 hered
itary self
hood and its
 accumulated
 ev
ils.
 It is cleansed and strips off
 the evil
 that was compounded with it from
 birth
 and
 from
 life
 in
 the world,
 and it
 becomes a state
 of recovered hol
iness.

**¶10.
** And also, what is called *
pristine* in the external
 natural sense corresponds to a person whose understanding
 has never been con
joined with the love of self and
 the world —
 who has not been contaminated by that
 conjunction. However, in
 contrast, what is called *recovered*
 corresponds to a person whose understanding was con
joined with worldly affection and
 self
-love in
 the course
 of natural
 life.
 Afterward, he separ
ates himself from that
 conjunction
 and renounces it.
 And because of this he is
 pur
ified,
 and he becomes a holy *
recovered* state.

**¶
11.** Behold, I
 have set
 forth
 the categories of the
 *pristine* and the *recovered
* in a
 great many aspects. For what is prist
ine wisdom
 —
 and
 otherwise what is wisdom
 recovered
 from
 falsity — exists
 in many forms and
 at
 every
 degree
 of the
 mind
,
 from
 the in
most celest
ial down
 to the ou
termost natural.

---

**
Translator
's note
:** The
 entire
 chapter
 artic
ulates a single
 spiritual
 law
 through
 successive
 degrees:
 there
 is wisdom
 that has
 never fallen
 into falsity (*
virg
inal*
 /
 *prist
ine*), and
 there
 is wisdom that descended
 into falsity and
 was regener
ated out
 of it (*continent* / *recovered
*). This corresponds precisely
 to what
 Swedenborg distingu
ishes as
 the innoc
ence of the
 celestial —
 which
 never
 passed
 through tem
ptation against
 its
 own quality
 — and
 the innocence of
 the spiritual,
 which is
 recovered through combat
 with evil
 and
 fals
ity. The text moves
 systemat
ically from
 the inner
most cosmic
 degree
 (
¶3–
4
),
 through intermediate
 degrees (¶5–8
), to the human
 internal
 (
¶9)
 and finally
 the natural-
external (¶10),
 showing
 the
 same
 law
 operating
 at every
 plane
 —
 which
 is itself
 the
 law of correspondence
.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Behold, I have taught you the categories [of] the v[ir]ginal and the continent in a great many [as]pects. For what is virginal, or otherwise what is [con]tinent, is in many forms.

What is called ‘virginal’ is assigned to the mystery of the aeons of greatness. And they called it ‘virginal’ by the category of all the light that did not [taste] of death, nor come to the enemy’s war.

However, what is called ‘continent’ occurs to the mystery of the light that came and was mixed with the darkness. It was defiled in bodies [ ... ] and went up to the light. [They] called [it ‘co]ntinent’.
Furthermore, the holy vir[gin]als [ ... ... ] should they come out against the en[emy ... ... not] taste death, nor [ ... ].
Furthermore, what is called [‘vi]rginal’ is this light that was purified by the ima[ge] of the [A]mbassador. It wen[t up and] attained [the] he[ights. It was] confirmed in the image of the gods.

Furthermore, what is named ‘virginal’ is the Light Mind, should he come and assume the images [of] the ele[ct]. However, on the other hand, what is called ‘contin[ent]’ is the new man, should it be purified from this old man. And it is cleansed and strips off the Sin that is compounded with it, and it becomes a continent one.

And also, what is called ‘virgi[n]al’ in the flesh, is a man if he has [ne]ver joined himself to woman, has not been defiled by intercourse. However, [i]n contrast, what is called ‘continent’, is the man who has a wom[a]n in the world. Afterwards, he cleanses himself from her [and] renounces her. And because of this he [ ... ] and he becomes an holy contin[en]t one.
